name: Abigail
detailed_description:
Five years after leaving Kiln Bay for the big city, a half-formed memory transports Abigail to her childhood bedroom. Stranded in Kiln, Abigail must navigate her splintered friend group, calm her worried mother, and reconnect with the place that shaped her. Explore Kiln’s vibrant handcrafted neighborhoods, each with their unique way of playing the ubiquitous folk game Azulejo. In this narrative-focused game, grapple with a past that doesn’t exist anymore and flickers of a future that doesn’t belong to her.

Azulejo: The Ever-Shifting Folk Game

Azulejo is the heart of Kiln Bay, a game played with pictographic clay tiles that carry meaning far beyond their simple shapes. But no two neighborhoods play it the same way—its rules are molded by the beliefs, traditions, and personalities of the people who live there. To understand Kiln, you must first understand Azulejo—and to master Azulejo, you must first understand the people.

Explore Abigail’s Handcrafted Hometown

Kiln Bay is a town unlike any other—tactile, vibrant, and deeply personal. Each of its five neighborhoods is built from a different artistic medium, shaping not just its appearance but the people who live there:

  • Argil (Clay) – Earthy and enduring, the people of Argil believe in fate and tradition. Let the mystical water pools reveal your fortune through Azulejo.

  • Stitch Hill (Felt) – Soft yet strong, a place where friendships are stitched together and tested. Argue, debate, and defend your choices in Azulejo’s ever-changing contests. Who would win a beauty pageant? Who would haunt your nightmares? Who would steal the moon right out of the sky?

  • Wharf (Collage) – A patchwork of ideas and collaboration. Here, Azulejo is about building something together—use your tiles to craft an evolving art piece.

  • West Kiln (Paint) – A district in motion, where every brushstroke tells a story and Azulejo is a game of pure strategy.

  • Pulp Heights (Papier-Mâché) – Ephemeral yet full of life, this bustling marketplace changes with the wind. Here, Azulejo becomes a game of negotiation, where every trade is a conversation about what truly has value.

A Story of Friendship, Change, and the Ghosts of Who We Used to Be

Before she left, Abigail was the unspoken center of her friend group—Chase, Dani, Joanna, Gabe, and Kate, her first love. Now, returning to Kiln, she finds them changed, just as she is. Some bonds have frayed, some wounds have yet to heal, and some things remain just as they were—beautiful, complicated, and unfinished.

Rekindle old friendships, uncover buried tensions, and decide what kind of place Kiln will hold in Abigail’s life. Is this a return home or a final goodbye?

Abigail is a narrative-driven adventure about memory, change, and the way places shape the people who leave them behind. Featuring a richly crafted world, a unique evolving folk game, and a deeply personal story, it invites players to step into a town where art, history, and relationships are woven together—one tile at a time.
